subject: planner: fix a panic during column pruning (#47883)
summary: Reviewed first-parent diff touching `pkg/planner/core/rule_join_reorder.go` and `pkg/executor/explain_test.go`. The fix changes join-reorder’s schema-restoring projection to `SetSchema(originalSchema.Clone())` so later column pruning (which mutates `LogicalProjection` schema slices in-place) can’t accidentally mutate a shared schema and panic; a regression test for issue #47331 is added. No remaining Blocker/High issues found, and the schema-clone fix is still present on `upstream/master`.
